title: Chapter 382 Ambush In The Grove
content:
Chapter 382 Ambush In The Grove

After obtaining everyone's consent, Wang Shuo finally formed a 100-man general force.

The general force was first responsible for identifying the other party's three suspected main bases.

The fake main base must not have much defensive power, and the general force can easily eliminate it.

After finding the real base, Lin Zhu was responsible for besieging it, making a feint attack, and forcing the other party to return for reinforcements.

Wang Shuo also thought about whether he could destroy the other party's base in one go.

But since the red team dared to lead the army to leave the base, the defensive power of the main base must be able to hold on until the reinforcements arrived.

So he gave up this idea.

Of course, as to whether to go all out directly, it depends on Lin Zhu's trial attack.

Soon, Wang Shuo came to the ambush site.

That is, the edge of the central grove close to the red team.

This place is the best ambush site. Even if someone on the red team sees through the ambush, they must pass through here to rescue the main base.

After arriving at the scheduled ambush site, Wang Shuo always felt something was wrong.

The main thing is that Wang Shuo has not yet explored what is deep in the jungle.

There are 30 generals and more than 2,000 generals in the ambush with Wang Shuo.

In addition to the people who attacked the red side's base, there is a separate team of 100 generals responsible for rushing to the rescue. This mobile force is now attacking the red side's base.

Most of the troops in the red side camp have been sent out, and less than one-third of the people are guarding the territory.

Therefore, the base used to confuse the purple side is completely vulnerable, and even the city wall has not been built.

The general team disintegrated it without any effort.

Then, they quickly swept and soon found the location of the main base. A tentative wave of attacks, but it did not achieve any results.

The red side base directly built a solid wall and erected dozens of arrow towers.

Compared with the defense of the purple side, it is much stronger.

Zhang Ren, the captain of the general team, shook his head helplessly after seeing it.

The subsequent attack was handed over to Lin Zhu, and Zhang Ren led the team of generals to join Wang Shuo.

After Zhang Ren told Wang Shuo about this situation, Wang Shuo was also surprised.

To build such a solid wall and so many defense towers, it would cost a lot of merit points.

It seems that the opponent must want to drag it to the later stage, stabilize the base first, and then kill the earth mother worm to obtain resources.

The generals on Wang Shuo's side exchanged soldiers as much as possible, while the red side did the opposite and first built the base into a turtle shell.

"Their number must not be as large as ours. As long as the other side comes back for help, we still have a great chance of winning this battle."

Not long after, Guo Liang came over and said, "Commander, we have already discovered that the people who went to ask for help have passed our ambush site. I believe it won't be long before the other side's large force will come back for help."

"Next, we will ambush and kill the opponent by surprise."

However, after waiting for more than an hour, the other side still did not come back for help, which made Wang Shuo a little uneasy. Could it be that the other side did not even think about going back for rescue? Are they really so confident that they can't break through the other side's base?

At this time, Wang Shuo also became a little suspicious.

Fortunately, not long after, a force came back for help from the opposite side.

But the number of this force was not large, only less than 1,000 people.

Obviously, it was not all the troops on the opposite side. In any case, Wang Shuo had no reason to let them go.

"All troops attack!"
